text: G Series LE｜M.2 2280 PCIe®4.0 NVMe™ Gaming SSD - Nextorage Nextorage EN Switch language Japanese English Français 中文 Deutsch EN Switch language Japanese English Français 中文 Deutsch Open G Series LE｜M.2 2280 PCIe ® 4.0 NVMe™ Gaming SSD 4 TB / 2 TB / 1 TB View Full Specs newegg.com Advanced SSD: Faster, More Stable G Series LE, equipped with the latest generation controller and 3D TLC NAND flash. The adoption of a DRAM-less design maintains high speed while reducing power consumption and temperature rise, thus enhancing stability during use. It ensures stability even during prolonged usage and offers outstanding performance and comfort for high-demand tasks such as high-end gaming and 4K+ video editing. Maximize the performance of your Gaming PC High-Speed Loading Achieves read speed of up to7,400 MB/s 1 . This high-speed startup is beneficial not only for quick game launches but also reduces loading times during fast travel and when entering dungeons in MMORPGs and open-world games with real-time loading of large maps. Reducing Lag and Processing Delay With up to 1,000,000 IOPS 1 in random read performance, this SSD can efficiently handle high-load graphic rendering. By reducing screen stuttering and processing drops, it offers a smoother and more seamless gaming experience, allowing you to play with tempo. Enhanced Stability Due to the energy-saving benefits of the DRAM-less design, power consumption is reduced, helping to minimize temperature increases. This allows the SSD to operate stably, maximizing the performance of gaming PCs and providing a more comfortable gaming environment. Reliable Durability Dynamic SLC Caching This contributes to a longer life by reducing the workload on the NAND while speeding up the transfer of frequently accessed data. Advanced wear-leveling Advanced wear-leveling algorithms efficiently and evenly distribute data write/erase cycles to each area of the NAND flash memory: contribute not only to improving performance but to extending the life of TLC NAND. LDPC The controller is equipped with LDPC (Low-Density Parity Check) ECC algorithm, which detects and corrects reading errors with high accuracy, and protects from data corruption caused by the aging of flash memory cells. Play without worry Quality tested In addition to general functional examinations, This product is Read/Write tested before shipment at higher temperatures specified by Nextorage. 5-year limited warranty Warranty valid for 5 years from the original date of purchase or before writing the maximum TBW (Total Bytes Written.) Compatibility ・Compatible with computers equipped with an M.2 (M Key) port supporting the M.2 2280 form factor. ・Supports PCIe 4.0 standard and NVMe protocol. Exclusive Offer for Nextorage SSD Purchasers SSD Suite for Nextorage Utility Software for Managing OS and Data Migration, and Monitoring the Health of Your SSD SSD Suite for Nextorage is a software product designed to support the migration of your OS and data from your current SSD to your newly purchased Nextorage SSD, enabling its use as a boot drive. It also allows you to manage the health of your SSD, securely delete data, update firmware, and more. The software can be used once it detects and activates the Nextorage SSD.
